Ordinary Council Meeting March 2023

Wednesday, March 22, 2023 - 10:00 AM

Location: 4 Scott Street, Gascoyne Junction WA 6705

Ordinary Council Meetings commence at 10:00am in the Shire Council Chambers located at 4 Scott Street, Gascoyne Junction with exception to the May 2023meeting - this will be held at Mount Augustus Tourist Park. Agendas will be made available prior to the meeting.

For more information regarding meeting dates please refer to the Public Notice section of our website or contact the Shire Office on (08) 9943 0988.
